business_problem: Paris 2024 needed to secure ticketing, volunteer, athlete, media, and official systems across a globally visible event while defending against leaks, breaches, sabotage, fraud, typosquatting, misinformation, and other cyberattacks that could disrupt competition delivery.
solution_summary: Paris 2024 worked with Eviden to build an operational AI-assisted cybersecurity stack around AIsaac, Eviden's AI-driven MDR platform, plus endpoint detection and response, threat intelligence, digital-risk monitoring, and round-the-clock response operations. Signals from more than 40 cybersecurity tools, Entra ID, public-facing applications such as ticketing and volunteer portals, and external partner feeds were brought into the operating model so detection logic, hunting queries, and automated workflows could run continuously before and during the Games. A dedicated Cybersecurity Operations Center in Paris, two supporting European operations centers, and Digital Forensics and Incident Response teams used AIsaac, a threat intelligence platform, and Digital Risk Protection Surveillance to share indicators, monitor public-domain abuse, investigate incidents, and coordinate remediation at event scale.

solution_components.name: AIsaac
solution_components.role: Served as Eviden's AI-driven MDR platform, integrating more than 40 cybersecurity tools and automating detection and response workflows.

solution_components.name: EDR
solution_components.role: Provided endpoint protection and detection during the protection phase, including hardened configurations against EDR-killer techniques.

solution_components.name: threat intelligence platform (TIP)
solution_components.role: Shared indicators and coordinated real-time threat information across Paris 2024, partners, and suppliers.

solution_components.name: Digital Risk Protection Surveillance (DRPS)
solution_components.role: Monitored public domains for exposed credentials, sensitive documents, fake domains, and related digital risks.

solution_components.name: Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC)
solution_components.role: Ran 24/7 monitoring and coordinated incident response from Paris with support from two European operations centers.

solution_components.name: Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR)
solution_components.role: Handled incident investigation and response when threats required deeper forensic analysis and coordinated remediation.

data_flow: Endpoint, identity, and application signals from ticketing, volunteer, athlete, media, and official systems flowed into Eviden's CSOC, where AIsaac orchestrated automated detection and response across 40+ security tools. DRPS added public-domain risk signals, the threat intelligence platform exchanged indicators with 25 partners, and CSOC plus DFIR teams investigated, coordinated, and closed incidents around the clock.
business_outcome: Paris 2024 analyzed 55 billion cybersecurity events, addressed more than 1,000 security tickets, ran more than 300 automated response workflows across 40+ integrated tools, shared intelligence with 25 partners, identified more than 400 fake ticketing websites, and finished the Games with zero incidents impacting operations.

source_references.title: Securing the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games | Eviden

evidence_quotes: 40+ cybersecurity tools integrated into AIsaac, our AI-driven MDR platform

An integrated approach included vulnerability management, real-time automated threat detection and response for 360-degree protection, with advanced services like AIsaac, Eviden's next generation cybersecurity detection and response platform.

By 2024, more than 100 Eviden cybersecurity experts were mobilized to ensure the safety and security of the Olympic and Paralympic Games. This operation included one dedicated Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC) located in Paris and two European Operations Centers providing additional support to the CSOC 24/7.

Deploying a dedicated threat intelligence platform (TIP) to protect Paris 2024 data, brand, partners, and suppliers facilitated real-time information sharing. This included more than 6 million indicators of compromise, and collaboration with 25 partner organizations, enabling proactive threat management.
After analyzing 55 billion cybersecurity events and addressing over 1,000 security tickets, we achieved the ultimate goal: zero incidents impacting the Paris 2024 Games.
